events.title: ECOSLO Cayucos Beach Cleanup – August
events.organizer: ECOSLO (Environmental Center of San Luis Obispo)
events.summary: Volunteer beach cleanup near the Cayucos Pier, removing litter from high-use visitor areas. Supplies provided; all welcome.

events.title: ECOSLO Cayucos Beach Cleanup – September
events.organizer: ECOSLO (Environmental Center of San Luis Obispo)
events.summary: Season-closing volunteer beach cleanup at Cayucos Pier, keeping the shoreline litter-free. Gloves, grabbers & bags supplied.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.summary: Classic and custom cars fill downtown Cayucos, paired with live music, a beer garden, and BBQ. Free to spectators; pre-reg required for exhibitors.

events.title: Cayucos Farmers Market
events.venue: Corner of D St. & Ocean Ave., Cayucos
events.summary: Seasonal open-air Friday market with local produce, flowers, baked goods, and artisan foods steps from the beach.

events.title: Schooners Beachside Live – Summer Concert Series
events.summary: Free outdoor weekend concerts at Schooners' beachfront patio featuring local and touring bands with ocean views all summer long.

events.title: Schooners Open Mic Night
events.summary: Weekly open-mic night at Schooners where local musicians and newcomers share the stage in a casual beachside setting.

events.title: Schooners Karaoke Night
events.summary: Hosted karaoke with a full A/V setup, fog machine, and crowd sing-alongs every 1st and 3rd Thursday at Schooners.
